title: Wing Anti-Ice Shut-Off Valve — Removal of the Solenoid and Position Sensing Assembly
abstract: Removal of the solenoid and the position sensing assembly from a wing anti-ice shut-off valve, including the pneumatic isolation and the travel measurement that is taken before the parts are disturbed.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the solenoid and the position sensing assembly from a wing anti-ice shut-off valve, and to record the valve travel time before removal where that measurement is required.
sections.job_setup_note: The pneumatic system must be depressurised and the wing anti-ice must be deselected and safetied at the flight deck before the leading edge panels are opened. The valve body stays on the aircraft; only the solenoid and the sensing assembly are removed. Where a travel time measurement is required it must be taken before the connector is disturbed, because reconnecting the connector resets the valve to its commanded position.
sections.procedure: 1. Deselect the wing anti-ice and put the warning notice in position at the flight deck. 2. Depressurise the pneumatic system and confirm zero pressure at the gauge. WARNING: DO NOT OPEN THE LEADING EDGE PANELS UNTIL THE DUCT HAS COOLED. THE DUCT SURFACE CAN STAY ABOVE 200 DEGREES CELSIUS FOR 30 MINUTES AFTER SHUTDOWN. 3. Open the leading edge access panels in zone 533. 4. Where a travel time measurement is required, connect the travel gauge at the valve connector and record the opening time. 5. Disconnect the valve connector and cap it. 6. Release the harness support clamp and lay the harness clear. 7. Remove the lockwire from the solenoid retaining nuts. 8. Remove the solenoid, keeping it square to the valve body. CAUTION: DO NOT TWIST THE SOLENOID DURING REMOVAL. THE ARMATURE IS A CLOSE FIT AND A TWISTED WITHDRAWAL BENDS IT. 9. Remove the position sensing assembly and the sealing washers. 10. Install the blanking plugs on the valve body openings. 11. Put the removed parts in a clean container and identify them by position.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the valve body openings are blanked and that the harness is supported and not resting on the duct. Leave the warning notice in position while the leading edge is open. Record the travel time measurement if one was taken, and the position each removed item came from.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Step 4 applies to aircraft pre MOD-146540 when TTN-30-1026 is being accomplished.

safety_precautions: Deselect the wing anti-ice and put the warning notice in position.
Let the duct cool before you open the leading edge panels.
